decision: Q2 (accepted, founder 2026-08-26): official release downloads, pinned version + hash verification, vendored OUTSIDE git (this manifest is the pinning record; binary blobs are never committed). Runtime wallet-API probe mandatory (a wavewalletrpc-only build silently stubs WalletService — probe Status and fail closed on Unimplemented).

verification.reproducible_build: make release tag=v0.1.2-rc3 (Go 1.26.0); verify with ./scripts/verify-install.sh v0.1.2-rc3 <path> (docs/release.md at the tag)
verification.provenance_status: REQUIRES VERIFICATION — whether the release archives are built with the wavewalletrpc+swapruntime tags is not provable from the manifest alone; the runtime wallet-API probe (WalletService.Status) at install time is the definitive check (Q2/SEC-2026-050).

steps: 1. Download the platform archive from the official release URL.
2. Verify sha256 of the archive AND of the extracted waved binary against this manifest.

3. Run the runtime wallet-API probe: start waved with the signet config (sidecar does this), call POST /v1/wallet/status; an Unimplemented/unknown-service answer means the build lacks wavewalletrpc+swapruntime — replace the artifact.
4. Point the supervisor at the binary via OMEGA_SOVEREIGN_WALLET_WAVED_BIN.
